messages:
Connor O'Brien: release coord for residency enforcement canary enablement. target window Thu 10:00–12:00 PT. need owners + checklist + rollback. dropping draft checklist below, please fill gaps.

Connor O'Brien: Checklist v0
1) Feature flag `residency_enforcement` on in canary cohort only
2) Verify policy-evaluator healthy (p95 < 20ms, error rate < 0.1%)
3) Gateway enforcement deployed to all hosted regions
4) Smart routing: cross-region fallback disabled when pinned (no silent fallback)
5) Audit events flowing to exporter (residency.policy_evaluated + residency.violation)
6) Dashboards + alerts temporarily widened for canary noise
7) E2E tests green + staging smoke
8) Support/CS comms + escalation path
9) Rollback plan agreed + tested (kill-switch)

Chris Osei: adding canary cohort list is in PM-482. proposing 8 orgs (5 EU-only + 3 US-only) w/ low traffic + TAM coverage. will post exact org ids in private note.

Naomi Feldman: for the canary, please ensure we are fail-closed for pinned orgs (deny if can’t evaluate policy) per ADR-043. exceptions only via explicit override + audit.

Sean Gallagher: :+1: on fail-closed but we need a super clear rollback lever. if policy-evaluator has an incident, we can’t take down canary customers for hours.

Marcus Lin: security stance is deny on unknown for pinned. but we can set canary to small + have a kill switch. we just need auditability when kill switch used.

Connor O'Brien: agree. rollback lever = disable flag in cohort. separate from “global fail-open”. we are NOT shipping a global fail-open toggle for residency in this phase.

Amara Diallo: gateway side: middleware is deployed in us-east + eu-west + ap-south as of yesterday. still rolling out to us-west (envoy config change queued). ETA 1h. we should not enable canary until all regions updated.

DeployBot: prod rollout status: gateway-us-west `residency-mw` at 60% (3/5 clusters). next wave in 25m.

Mina Haddad: routing change is in pr_18452 and is already in prod behind flag `routing_residency_guardrails`. currently OFF. for canary we need both flags enabled for the cohort otherwise gateway denies but router could still attempt fallback retries.

Rafael Mendes: what’s the on-call coverage for the window? I can cover from SRE side but need a playbook + alert thresholds.

Sergio Costa: dashboards/alerts ready in observability-pack pr_417. once merged, we’ll have:
- `residency_violation_rate{org_tier,region}`
- `policy_eval_errors_total`
- `gateway_residency_denies_total{reason}`
Alert suggestion for canary: page only if deny rate > 2% for 10m OR policy-eval errors > 0.5% for 5m.

Leila Farouk: QA: e2e test `pinned_eu_hits_us_endpoint_denied` is green in staging. still need a prod smoke: call US base URL with EU-pinned key and confirm 403 + error code + audit event.

Connor O'Brien: assigning owners:
- Canary cohort toggle + schedule: Connor
- Cohort list + customer comms: Chris / Naomi
- Gateway deploy confirm all regions: Amara
- Routing flag enable + verification: Mina
- Metrics/dashboards + alert tuning: Sergio / Rafael
- Smoke + e2e checkoffs: Leila
- Audit events + exporter spot check: Marcus / Logan

Logan Wright: telemetry: audit events are emitted by redwood pr_18466. exporter pr_141 includes event filters. I’ll validate in prod by querying last 15m for `residency.policy_evaluated` once canary is on.

Sean Gallagher: can we confirm error contract version? support needs to know exact fields: `code`, `message`, `remediation`, `docs_url`, `request_id`.

Amara Diallo: gateway returns `403` with `RESIDENCY_REGION_MISMATCH` when endpoint region != pinned/allowed. if policy is missing/invalid it returns `403` `RESIDENCY_POLICY_REQUIRED` for enterprise pinned orgs. request id is `x-redwood-request-id`.

Naomi Feldman: please ensure copy mentions “use the EU base URL / set client region” and includes docs link. don’t mention internal flags.

Connor O'Brien: go/no-go gates for the window:
A) gateway-us-west rollout complete
B) policy-evaluator green (SLO ok)
C) dashboard live
D) support aware (Dev Patel ack)
E) rollback tested in staging (toggle off returns traffic to normal)

Rafael Mendes: re: rollback tested — can we do a quick staging drill today? simulate canary deny spike and toggle off. I can run.

Mina Haddad: staging drill ok. note: if both flags are on and we disable only `routing_residency_guardrails`, gateway will still deny mismatched regions, so rollback is mostly `residency_enforcement` at gateway level.

Connor O'Brien: yep rollback = disable `residency_enforcement` for cohort (gateway stops enforcing). keep routing guardrails on/off doesn’t matter once gateway no longer denies, but we’ll revert both to be safe.

Marcus Lin: please log an audit event when the flag is changed for the cohort. we need evidence that we intentionally disabled enforcement if we do.

Logan Wright: flag changes are already audited in control plane (`admin.config_changed`). not a residency event but includes actor + diff. should be acceptable for evidence.

Sergio Costa: FYI alert noise: during canary enable we’ll see expected denies for “misconfigured clients” (hitting wrong base URL). recommend we page only for policy-evaluator errors / elevated 5xx. denies should be ticket-level unless they exceed the threshold.

Sean Gallagher: +1. denies are “correct behavior” unless it’s mass denial due to our bug. can we add a panel splitting reasons: `region_mismatch` vs `policy_eval_unavailable` vs `invalid_policy`?

Sergio Costa: already in the dashboard JSON stub. `reason` label is set in gateway. panel will show breakdown.

DeployBot: prod rollout status: gateway-us-west `residency-mw` at 100% (5/5 clusters).

Amara Diallo: confirmed us-west is now consistent. I’ll do a quick spot check: request without pinning passes, request with pinning denies cross-region.

Leila Farouk: when ready I can run prod smoke with one of the canary orgs (EU pinned) once cohort enabled.

Chris Osei: comms: I’ll ping TAMs + Support that canary starts Thu 10am PT, expect possible new 403 denies for wrong endpoint, and share troubleshooting snippet.

Connor O'Brien: Action items before Thu 10am PT:
- Amara: paste gateway verification results
- Sergio/Rafael: finalize alert thresholds + link dashboard
- Logan/Marcus: confirm exporter query + sample payload
- Leila: staging rollback drill w/ Rafael

Rafael Mendes: I’ll schedule the staging drill today 3pm PT. I’ll report back w/ screenshots + any gotchas.

Connor O'Brien: perfect. if anything blocks, reply here + tag me. otherwise we proceed Thu.

Sean Gallagher: reminder: if we see policy-evaluator latency spikes, first mitigation is scale policy-evaluator + increase cache TTL (if safe). rollback is last resort.

Connor O'Brien: noted. adding to run-of-show for Thu: check policy-eval p95 + cache hit ratio at T-15m.

Naomi Feldman: thanks all. please keep the canary tight; we’ll use results to set GA criteria for enterprise default-on.
